verdict.rationale: Google Workspace is a SaaS suite with built-in AI (Gemini), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a control or commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The only AI-related items are the Gemini assistant listing and admin settings for Meet's 'Take notes for me', which are adjacent features and not training-data controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
